---
title: "Today at a glance"
---

```{r}
source("R/weather.R")
source("R/dashboard.R")
snapshot <- read_dashboard_snapshot()
payload <- snapshot$payload
current <- payload$current
daily <- dashboard_daily(snapshot)[1, ]
hourly <- hourly_frame(payload, snapshot$timezone)
best <- dashboard_best_hour(hourly, dashboard_now(snapshot), snapshot$timezone)
```

::: {.hero}
# Copenhagen weather

`r weather_description(current$weather)` · Updated `r format(as_local_time(current$dt), "%H:%M")`
:::

::: {.grid}
::: {.metric}
## Now
`r sprintf("%.0f°C", current$temp)`

Feels like `r sprintf("%.0f°C", current$feels_like)`
:::
::: {.metric}
## Today
`r sprintf("%.0f / %.0f°C", daily$max_temp, daily$min_temp)`

High / low
:::
::: {.metric}
## Rain chance
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", daily$pop)`

Wind `r sprintf("%.0f m/s", daily$wind_speed)`
:::
::: {.metric}
## Best outside
`r if (nrow(best) && is.finite(best$score[1])) format(best$time[1], "%H:%M", tz = snapshot$timezone) else "Unavailable"`

Score `r if (nrow(best) && is.finite(best$score[1])) sprintf("%.0f / 100", best$score[1]) else "Unavailable"`
:::
:::

## The next 24 hours

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(head(hourly, 24), aes(time, temp)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, colour = "#6ee7ff") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = pop), size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "#a7f3d0", high = "#60a5fa", name = "Rain chance %") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Temperature °C") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

Sunrise `r format(daily$sunrise, "%H:%M")` · Sunset `r format(daily$sunset, "%H:%M")`
